html:
We felt our parents were unfair when we were growing up, but later we realized how it shaped us. Teachers being unfair helped us try more. Seniors being unfair made us smarter. Bosses being unfair helped us challenge our limitations and grow beyond what we thought we would, but still, we feel being unfair is bad.


The matter of fact is that, Unfortunately, life isn’t fair. The better you accept this premise, the more able you will be to manage those inevitable, unjust events.


Fight with everything that is unfair, but never run away from it. It is here to make you better. In conclusion, while being treated unfairly may seem negative in the moment, it can ultimately lead to personal growth and development. It is important to accept that life is not always fair and to use these experiences as opportunities to challenge ourselves and become stronger individuals.
